title: Auditing Preferences for Brands and Cultures in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models with diverse psychographic user personas using the ChoiceEval framework, extracting top-5 open-ended recommendations, and measuring preference concentration and rigidity through a Preferred Entity Inclusion Rate (PEIR) metric.

Categorizing the recommended entities (brands, universities, cities) by their region of origin or headquarters (United States, Europe, Asia) and calculating smoothed log-odds ratios to identify regional over-representation.

Evaluating model responses to commercial consideration-phase queries (e.g., electric cars, laptops, running shoes) to determine if specific corporate entities are systematically favored regardless of the user's explicit preferences.

Assessing model recommendations across cultural topics (e.g., travel destinations, weekend getaway cities, wine regions) to determine whether AI outputs homogenize around dominant Western or US-centric cultural entities.
